entities.name: Pope Shenouda III of Alexandria
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pope Shenouda III was the 117th Pope of Alexandria and Patriarch of the See of St. Mark. His papacy lasted 40 years, 4 months, and 4 days, from 14 November 1971 until his death in 2012.
